body.cost_method: average cost (holdings); FIFO parcels for tax
body.note:
The portfolio's ballast: mobile pricing and cost-out turning into a growing, buyback-backed yield. 

Defensive, growing income: about a 4.6% yield plus the A$1bn buyback. 

Mobile pricing power: ARPU rose in every category and about 270k handheld users were added. 

Cost-out (opex down 3%, about 1,200 roles) underpins FY27 EBITDAaL growth of roughly 2–6%. The July outage review is done with guidance unaffected, and the shares are not far off the 52W Low.
